{{Quote|I have a stack of books, the ''Meatlump Manifesto'', that need to be handed out to people across the Galaxy.|Recruiter Joe|<ref name="SWG:MR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Meatlump Recruiter}}</ref>}}
The '''''Meatlump Manifesto''''' was the manifesto of [[Meatlumps]], a gang of technology-hating ruffians. Meatlump member [[Joe]] had stacks of the [[Book/Legends|book]] which he hoped to disseminate to potential recruits.<ref name="SWG:MR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Recruiter Joe tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with traveling [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and handing out the ''Meatlump Manifesto'' in order to attract new recruits.<ref name="SWG:MR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Meatlump Manifesto'' was an item in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The ''Meatlump Manifesto'' was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]", introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
